articles.title: Government's Silence on Fuel Price Reduction Amid Brent Crude Volatility
articles.titleEn: Government's Silence on Fuel Price Reduction Amid Brent Crude Volatility
articles.summary: The government has not committed to reducing petrol and diesel prices despite falling Brent crude prices, citing continued volatility due to the West Asia crisis. Public sector oil companies face significant financial losses, and no timeline is provided for potential price reductions.
